# CashAutoUAE (كاش أوتو الإمارات)

> CashAutoUAE buys used cars for cash across all seven UAE emirates. Sellers get a free valuation, a free inspection at a location that suits them, same-day payment and free ownership transfer. The site is available in English and Arabic.

Key facts:
- Service: used car buying and instant cash valuation (UAE only)
- Areas served: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain
- Buys all types: luxury, SUV, family, performance, commercial; also financed (bank loan) cars
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 55 919 8586
- Email: info@cashautouae.com
- Based in Dubai, UAE
- Hours: Saturday–Thursday 09:00–19:00, Friday 16:00–21:00
- Languages: English, Arabic

- [Home](https://cashautouae.com/): how selling a car to CashAutoUAE works, FAQs
